instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020G at completeness/governance lens. Slice claims to deliver the 4 acceptance criteria from WP-SCP-020 §4 020G: (i) header asserts gh-version + jq + PAT scopes; (ii) refuses without --repo/--branch + --plan flag + --enforce-admins defaults true; (iii) logs invocation to docs/reviews/WP-SCP-020/branch-protection-log.md (commit is part of invocation procedure); (iv) bootstrap-only header declares not unattended. VERIFY EACH: (1) (i): gh-version assertion present? jq + git require_cmd checks present? PAT scope: documented but not introspected (acceptable per dispatch-note's reasoning). Is the documentation clear about which scope is needed (administration:write on the single target repo only)? (2) (ii): --repo + --branch refusal verified by command-line parse + explicit error. --plan flag implemented (PLAN_ONLY=1). --enforce-admins default true via ENFORCE_ADMINS=true initial value; --no-enforce-admins opts out. Is the spec wording 'flag defaults true' satisfied — i.e., is --enforce-admins a no-op flag (since it's the default), or does it need an actual setter? Verify spec intent. (3) (iii): The script emits a markdown block for the operator to paste. The log COMMIT requires the operator to manually paste + commit + open PR. Is this 'commit is part of invocation procedure' acceptable, or should the script automate the commit (e.g., via gh API to create a PR)? Flag if the spec strictly requires automated logging. (4) (iv): bootstrap-only assertion appears in usage()/--help output. Verify it's clear enough that an automation tool would reject the script. (5) Cross-reference with WP-SCP-020 §4 020G text — anything missing? E.g., the spec says 'header asserts gh --version >= 2.40' — is the actual minimum the script needs (rulesets API was added in gh 2.20-ish; admin flags came earlier). Is the 2.40 floor correct? (6) docs/reviews/WP-SCP-020/branch-protection-log.md format: the file ships empty (no invocations). Format-doc explains how to populate. Is this acceptable for the slice landing, or does the spec require at least one example entry? Cross-reference with the spec. (7) DISPATCH-NOTE.md lists 'Bootstrap-only header declares this script is not run unattended' as criterion (iv). Is this satisfied via just the --help text, or does the script also assert (e.g., refuse to run when CI=true)? Estate-standard for similar scripts (configure-020j, configure-020d2) — do they have a CI guard? (8) WP-SCP-020 §4 020G text doesn't mention adopter-side renovate/preset extension. Should this slice also produce a companion script or doc that wires up the Renovate preset extends?. (Probably not — preset usage is documented at 020H part 3 in the canonical adopter wrapper appendix.) Confirm. (9) The log file's 'Why log on SCP repo' section: does it correctly enumerate the audit-trail rationale? (10) Cross-reference with D-022 + D-030 + D-032 + D-034: should this slice file a D-NNN ratifying the adopter-helper invocation procedure? Or is the existing decision chain sufficient? Any missing acceptance criterion, undocumented assumption, or cross-doc inconsistency is a finding. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
